text: The robot delivered 1 order out of 112 (9%) successfully, with an average time of 67 seconds per order and a median of 57 seconds. The top failure reason was [[reachability]]_failed, affecting orders #403 (pen) and #892 (t-shirt). Orders that took over 2 minutes to complete were often flagged with warnings or failed due to this issue. To address the frequent reachability failures, ensure the robot's path is clear before initiating a new order.
